question: Does invertible higher-dimensional signed-Hadamard mixing make the live compact full-MLP temporal source accurately codable by the same byte-rate pair-product quantizer?

causal_parent.reason: Free pair directions did not solve the live source-coding problem, so the frozen successor is a higher-dimensional lattice, trellis, or product code rather than more pair centroids.

theory.transform: u = H_B S_B e and e_hat = S_B H_B^T u_hat, where H_B is normalized Hadamard and S_B is a deterministic sign diagonal
theory.support: The transform is bijective and orthogonal, so it removes no ambient direction and preserves squared error exactly.
theory.coding_effect: Mixing spreads sparse/heavy-tailed coordinates and cross-weight correlations over B transformed coordinates before product quantization.
theory.persistent_state: unchanged; two uint8 codes per transformed pair, one byte per original weight, no stored transform, no dense master, no dense momentum, no ambient residual

aggregation.residual_stage_recovery: residual-target-energy weighted across all 24 matrices, separately by block size and probe step, plus minimum matrix recovery
aggregation.full_feedback_recovery: feedback-target-energy weighted across all 24 matrices, separately by block size and probe step
aggregation.occupancy_entropy: minimum over both stages, all matrices, and both probe steps for each block size
aggregation.parseval: maximum matrix relative energy error over both probe steps

selection_rule.winner: smallest block size greater than 2 that passes every candidate and validity gate at both steps
selection_rule.ties: smallest block wins because it has the least transform work and shortest correlation span
selection_rule.B2: control only; cannot be selected because the parent already rejected untransformed pair coding

decision_policy.winner_exists: Implement production carry only for the selected block size, then require focused tests and an exact-config MFU/optimizer-overhead gate followed by a nine-update local-recoding direction gate. No 238-step run or endpoint yet.
decision_policy.no_winner: Close fixed orthogonal mixing around pair-product VQ and derive a true higher-dimensional lattice or trellis at the compact-state budget. Do not sweep LR, bit rate, model size, or horizon.

execution_policy.preflight: foreground exact-config real-training preflight; diagnostic compute is included in measured optimizer time
execution_policy.scientific_run: foreground-polled because nine updates are expected under five minutes; attach a persistent @Codex watchdog immediately only if observed runtime exceeds five minutes
execution_policy.callbacks: none expected for a sub-five-minute diagnostic
